lines.trans: Ahead of the change of imperial era, we plan to intensify law enforcement.
Very soon, the era itself will change.
To secure public safety, carry out simultaneous mass arrests steadily.
When that day arrives, networks will suspend variety broadcasts for one week.
We will sweep Tokyo clean all at once. Get started immediately.
